goals.name: Mover Training App — Company-Wide Rollout + Driver-Training Port + Digital Training Handbook
goals.assessment: Still Red on the 70%-through-pipeline gate, but the trend is now decisively green and the lever is proven two weeks running. After catching an error in the Training Camp numbers and shipping the manager-requested fixes, engagement jumped to 73% (192 of 263 movers on track or at risk: 115 on track, 77 at risk, 68 behind, 3 not started/locked) and behind dropped from 147 to 68 in a week. The hard 50%-per-branch line landed everywhere except South Austin (44%: 8 on track/8 at risk/20 behind). Range now: Tampa 100, San Antonio 96, Fort Worth 94, McKinney 90, Leander 86, Dallas 83, Houston 64, Garland 60, North Austin 59, South Austin 44. Green gate is still 70% through the pipeline (Lead-Ready) by 10/19 — engagement is the leading indicator, not the gate, so the work now shifts from 'get them active' to 'move them through the stages.'
blockers: South Austin the only branch under the 50% engagement line (44%)
Green gate = 70% through pipeline (Lead-Ready) by 10/19 — engagement high but pipeline completion is the real bar
